findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと試合をする事もできない
findings.governingReading: I cannot have a bout with Saber
findings.explanation: The specific inability to spar because of Shirou’s lingering paralysis becomes inability to train in any fashion.

findings.evidenceJa: 物騒な話をする気分でもない
findings.governingReading: talking about grim and violent matters
findings.explanation: The emotional burden of discussing killing and war becomes the vague category “dangerous things.”

findings.highlight: worried if you like my food or not
findings.evidenceJa: 喜んでもらえているか不安
findings.governingReading: worried whether the meals are making you happy
findings.explanation: Shirou’s concern for Saber’s pleasure and satisfaction narrows to whether she approves of his food.

findings.evidenceJa: 雰囲気一転
findings.governingReading: The atmosphere changes completely
findings.explanation: A sudden tonal shift in the exchange becomes a fundamental change in Saber herself.

findings.evidenceJa: とても真剣にこっちを見据える
findings.governingReading: fixes me with an unexpectedly serious gaze
findings.explanation: Saber’s focused, almost confrontational gaze is weakened to generic watching.

findings.evidenceJa: 礼儀正しく正座する
findings.governingReading: formally seats herself in seiza
findings.explanation: A named formal posture and its ceremonious execution become a vague cultural label.

findings.highlight: pumped up as if she’s about to start a match
findings.evidenceJa: 一試合始めるぐらい気合が入ってる
findings.governingReading: focused with enough fighting spirit to begin a match
findings.explanation: The mock-martial seriousness is recast in casual modern slang that loosens Saber’s register.

findings.evidenceJa: 早く早く、と無言で急かしてくる
findings.governingReading: Silently, she presses me to hurry—quickly, quickly
findings.explanation: The repeated urgency that makes Saber comically eager for better meals disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちもキチンと正座して
findings.governingReading: I, too, sit properly in seiza
findings.explanation: Shirou mirroring Saber’s formal posture is again reduced to a vague cultural description.

findings.evidenceJa: 瑞々しい野菜
findings.governingReading: fresh, succulent vegetables
findings.explanation: The desirable freshness and moisture of vegetables become ripeness, an unnatural quality for much of the category.

findings.highlight: I will not ask for much
findings.evidenceJa: そのような贅沢は言いません
findings.governingReading: I would make no such extravagant demands
findings.explanation: Saber refuses the very idea of specifying meats and cooking methods; the English only says her requests will be modest.

findings.highlight: Meat is the primary part of the meal
findings.evidenceJa: 肉料理は食事の華だ
findings.governingReading: Meat dishes are the flower—the highlight—of a meal
findings.explanation: A celebratory metaphor for meat as a meal’s showpiece becomes a nutritional or structural claim that it is the primary component.

findings.highlight: Everything you have cooked was splendid
findings.evidenceJa: 全て驚くほど美味しかった
findings.governingReading: Everything you cooked for me was astonishingly delicious
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicit praise of taste and its surprising degree becomes broad approval.

findings.evidenceJa: 怨念のこもった感想
findings.governingReading: an impression laden with deep resentment
findings.explanation: The comic image of a long-nursed grudge becomes direct hatred.

findings.evidenceJa: いたらぬ部下に対する不満
findings.governingReading: dissatisfaction with inadequate subordinates
findings.explanation: Saber’s imagined relationship to retainers or subordinates becomes contempt for people generally, weakening the rulerly characterization.

findings.highlight: An evil emotion unsuited to Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 自己嫌悪の具現みたいな、セイバーにあるまじき負の感想
findings.governingReading: a negative judgment unworthy of Saber, almost the embodiment of self-loathing
findings.explanation: A complex, partly comic narrator inference becomes a simple morally evil emotion and drops the self-loathing mechanism.

findings.evidenceJa: 食すまでの手間
findings.governingReading: the trouble required before one can eat it
findings.explanation: The burden of preparing and handling seafood through the point of eating is narrowed to cooking alone.

findings.highlight: and stuff like vegetables, meat, and fish
findings.evidenceJa: 野菜も肉も魚も大好き
findings.governingReading: you love vegetables, meat, and fish
findings.explanation: Shirou’s amused escalation to loving every category becomes casual, weaker liking and adds filler “stuff like.”

findings.evidenceJa: どうしてもダメな食べ物
findings.governingReading: any food you absolutely cannot stand
findings.explanation: A question about categorical aversion becomes one about physical or medical inability to eat.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how angry Saber will get
findings.evidenceJa: 機嫌がどう転ぶかわからない
findings.governingReading: there is no telling which way Saber’s mood will turn
findings.explanation: mirror moon promotes the possibility of an unpredictable bad mood into certainty that Saber will become angry, then varies only its degree.
